fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior and Sold Post without consideration are not assigned prices.
Withdrawn Prior and Withdrawn Post are not represented as completed sales or current availability.
Unreadable official update endpoints are not reconstructed or guessed.
Short licences and historical AST terms are not represented as current occupation after their stated periods.
Future RPI and open-market reviews are not treated as current rent.
Conditional GBP1 freehold options are not represented as exercised.
Ground rents are not confused with occupational income.
Vacant possession is not represented as income-producing occupation.
Planning approvals and development opportunities are not represented as implemented, subsisting or valued outcomes.
VAT splits and TOGC conditions remain separate and conditional.
Active company status and registered charges do not imply covenant strength or property-level lease performance.
Legal-pack EPC, title, update and lease details are not filled by inference.
